_help: PLACEHOLDER FOODS (2026-11-24) - names, species and chances are NOT final, edit freely. Each food: 'likes' = Pokémon display names (variants match too: 'Rattata' covers 019_Rattata_Alolan), 'chance' = % a liked Pokémon befriends you when offered one (talking to it on land, or landing it on the rod while the food is in your bag), 'description' = bag/shop text for later. Read by Scripts/Objects_And_Classes/Overworld_Pokemon/Following_Pokemon.gd. Give foods in-game with the DEL menu's 'Give test foods' button.

Rat Cheese.description: A pungent wedge of cheese. Small rodent Pokémon can't resist it.

Luscious Leaves.description: Crisp, juicy leaves that bug Pokémon love to munch.

Nutritious Bird Seed.description: A seed mix for bird Pokémon.

Fish Flakes.description: Flaky fish food. A fish that bites while you carry it may want to come with you.
